notes: The America 250 plate is a front-only commemorative cover plate (HB 260, $25, displayable Jan 1, 2026 to Jul 4, 2027); its image is from a town police page (sunapeenh.gov), not NH DMV, and the page doesn't caption it, so verify. NH's 14 charity decals on Multi-Use Decal plates (Patriots Foundation, UNH, Keene State, Rotary, etc.) aren't in the game and have no dates of addition on the DMV page; HB 1329 (2024) fire-department plates passed but I could not confirm they're issued or that they are for private cars.
